name: Chase Sapphire Reserve

otherLounges: Chase Sapphire Lounges by The Club
loungeAccess.notes: Unlimited visits to 1,300+ Priority Pass lounges worldwide and Chase Sapphire Lounges (currently DFW, LAX, BOS, JFK, LGA, ORD, PHL, PHX, SAN). Up to 2 complimentary guests per visit.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100/day for up to 5 days.

emergencyMedical.notes: Emergency Evacuation and Transportation: up to $100,000 for medical services and transportation if injured/ill 100+ miles from home. Emergency Medical and Dental: up to $2,500 (subject to $50 deductible) for medical expenses while traveling. These are SEPARATE benefits — evacuation covers transport, medical/dental covers treatment costs.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide. Country exclusions may apply — check current benefit guide.

hotelCredit.notes: Up to $500/year in statement credits for prepaid stays with The Edit by Chase Travel (up to $250 per transaction, 2-night minimum). Additional $250 credit through 12/31/26 for select Chase Travel hotels (IHG, Montage, Omni, etc.).

otherCredits.name: Annual Travel Credit
otherCredits.notes: Automatic statement credit on first $300 of travel purchases each anniversary year.

otherCredits.name: Dining Credit
otherCredits.notes: Up to $150 Jan-Jun + $150 Jul-Dec at Sapphire Exclusive Tables restaurants on OpenTable.

otherCredits.name: Apple Subscriptions
otherCredits.notes: Up to $24/month for Apple TV+ and Apple Music family plan.

rewards.travelRate: 8x on all purchases through Chase Travel (including The Edit); 4x on flights booked direct; 4x on hotels booked direct; 3x on general travel after $300 credit

travelPerks: $300 annual travel credit (automatic, applied to first travel purchases)
Primary rental car insurance up to $75,000
Priority Pass Select — unlimited visits to 1,300+ lounges worldwide
Chase Sapphire Lounges — complimentary access at select US airports
1:1 point transfer to 14+ airline and hotel partners
Emergency evacuation up to $100,000 and emergency medical up to $2,500
$120 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck/NEXUS credit every 4 years
bestFor: Frequent international travelers who value lounge access, primary rental car insurance, comprehensive travel protection, and flexible point transfers
